title: Registry: full health (Harbor components + PG/Redis repl + S3 + VIP)
description: Runs `nexus health registry`. Probes the Harbor /api/v2.0/health component checklist (core/db/redis/registry/registryctl/jobservice/portal/trivy) on both app nodes, the systeminfo auth_mode (OIDC SSO), the PostgreSQL streaming replication, the Redis master/replica link, the MinIO s3://harbor backend, and the VRRP VIP. On the healed tier all probes are green.

observe.what: harbor-app 2/2 healthy; harbor-components 8/8 healthy; harbor-systeminfo auth_mode=oidc_auth; pg-replication 1 streaming standby; redis master + 1 linked replica; s3-backend minio 200; VIP .119 bound; overall green

whatProves: RegistryAdapter.HealthAsync rolls the Harbor component checklist + PG streaming replication + Redis replication + the MinIO S3 backend + the VRRP VIP into one report. The s3-backend probe is the cross-tier trust canary (200 only when Harbor + MinIO share the same Vault root — the v0.8.5 rebuild put both on new-root).
